description:
After `1 / 0` is rescued, `IO.inspect(e)` prints `%{__exception__: true, __struct__: ArithmeticError, message: ...}` on interp and `%ArithmeticError{...}` on run and build. Same for MatchError and every other failure the compiler raises itself.

Cause (measured at develop 4f8b72ea4): both paths build a compiler-raised exception as a map in the entries layout (`fz_runtime::failure::exception_of`, `alloc_map_slots`), from a name and a field list. It prints as a struct only when the struct's schema is registered: native registers every schema at start (`fz_aot_register_named_schemas`, native_codegen/driver.rs), interp registers one when a struct of it is first built (ir_interp/backend.rs ProgramStep::Struct). Printing `%ArithmeticError{}` once beforehand makes interp agree.

A second copy of the same fact: `src/dispatch_matrix/pattern/last_resort.rs` lists each built-in exception's fields and defaults by hand (`ArgumentError` message "argument error", `Protocol.UndefinedError` description ""), duplicating `lib/exceptions/*.fz`.

Proposal page first: ../fz-3sy.30.html.
title: A raised exception is the struct its module declares, built one way on interp and native
